snippets: All items must incorporate a human touch as outlined by the categories below.
Digital downloads of sellers' original designs: original content created by the seller, sold as a digital download.
Seller-prompted AI creations: creations generated using AI tools based on a seller's original prompts.
Sellers must disclose within their listing description if an item is created with the use of AI.
The following are examples of items that do not qualify as 'designed by a seller': A bundle, collection, scan, or PDF of someone else's work; AI prompt bundles.
Sellers remain obligated to pay any fees incurred in listing such items.
Listings for items 'made by a seller' must use original photo or video content of the final product.
